items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: We had a program. We had Sidney Bechet and Louis Armstrong and Jay C. Higginbotham, and the rest they had the house band.

ctx.x: The producer. We had a program. We had Sidney Bechet and Louis Armstrong and Jay C. Higginbotham, and the rest they had the house band. You do your solo. They gave you a script to read. That's when they changed - was it Bourbon Street? It was another street. Q: Beale Street?
And changed it back to Beale Street or Bourbon Street. It's been the same street ever since - Bourbon Street.
